name: openkeylet
description: OpenKeylet — a local password and credential manager for AI agents.

scripts.release:mac: npm run build:mac && npm run portable:mac
scripts.release:linux: npm run build:linux && npm run portable:linux
scripts.release:headless: npm run build:headless && npm run portable:headless
scripts.test:browser: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example browser_fixture && node scripts/test-browser.mjs
scripts.test:login-capture: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example browser_fixture && node scripts/test-login-capture.mjs
scripts.test:login-flows: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example browser_fixture && node scripts/test-login-flows.mjs
